hard_invariants: There is one canonical local artifact truth for shared Doré knowledge.
Search indexes are projections and can be destroyed/rebuilt without losing truth.
Every protected mutation is revision-gated and leaves immutable history.
Every promoted research claim can carry provenance without requiring a heavyweight ontology runtime.
No product may fork shared memory/retrieval into a private second brain.
New dependencies must reduce total system burden or remain optional adapters.
